assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide closing CTA background photograph for Continex Global's crisis management and strategic resilience article. Premium corporate editorial photography, landscape 1536x1024. Coastal lighthouse on a solid stone breakwater, viewed obliquely across deep blue water after a storm. Cloud cover clearing with natural warm sunlight illuminating the lighthouse and textured sea, a calm distant commercial coastline. Restrained navy, steel blue, warm stone palette matching a sophisticated international advisory website. Strong readable scene surviving a panoramic crop across the middle third; lighthouse on right third, uncluttered darker sea on left for a translucent text panel. Crisp realistic architectural detail, believable sea, reassuring stability and direction. No text, logos, watermarks, diagrams, overlays or frames.
